description: This test ensures that a user can log in to the platform using their GitHub account via the OAuth flow.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Click on the GitHub login button.
Verify that the user is redirected to the GitHub OAuth authentication page.
Enter valid GitHub account credentials and submit.
Verify that the user is redirected back to the platform dashboard.
Check that the user is logged in and their GitHub profile data is displayed on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is redirected to GitHub's OAuth page.
User can authenticate using valid GitHub credentials.
User is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai and logged in successfully.
User's GitHub profile details are displayed on the dashboard.
edge_cases: Verify behavior when the user cancels login on the GitHub OAuth page.
Verify behavior when the user provides invalid GitHub credentials.
Verify behavior when GitHub's OAuth service is down.
Verify behavior when the redirect URI is tampered with.
Verify behavior when the user's GitHub account lacks a public email address.
data_requirements: A valid GitHub account with email and password.
OAuth client ID and secret configured for the application.
A redirect URI correctly set in the GitHub OAuth configuration.
Access to the GitHub OAuth authentication page.
Network connectivity for API calls to GitHub's servers.
dependencies: GitHub OAuth service must be operational.
User's GitHub account must be active.
The platform must have a configured GitHub OAuth client ID and secret.
api_interactions: Platform backend API to link GitHub account data with the user profile.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect to GitHub's OAuth page.
Time taken to authenticate via GitHub.
Time taken to return to the platform after successful authentication.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that the GitHub login button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Ensure that the GitHub login button has appropriate ARIA labels.
Verify that screen readers can identify and describe the GitHub login button accurately.
Ensure high contrast visibility of the GitHub login button.
